# Ecuador Gasto
Public Ecuador procurement awards from SERCOP. Independent project.

- MCP endpoint: https://ecuador-gasto.davo20019.workers.dev/mcp
- Transport: stateless Streamable HTTP, no authentication, read-only.
- Documentation: https://ecuador-gasto.davo20019.workers.dev/developers
- Metadata: https://ecuador-gasto.davo20019.workers.dev/api/meta

Tools: get_dataset_info, search_entities (query, kind, province, limit, offset), get_entity (ruc), list_provinces (local_only).
Resource: ecuador-gasto://dataset/info

Check metadata for coverage and generation date. Data is a static snapshot of awards, not live data, actual payments or total budgets. Province is inferred from buyer RUC and may reflect historical boundaries/headquarters. Signals are not evidence of wrongdoing. Supplier identifiers are omitted. Cite SERCOP and CC BY 3.0 EC.
